income_tax_bands_and_rates.notes: Standard rate 20%, higher rate 40%. Bands confirmed for 2024-2026 from Revenue tax relief charts and Budget announcements.

tax_credits.notes: Personal, employee (PAYE), earned income, home carer, SPCCC credits confirmed from Revenue. 2025/2026 increases from Budget 2025.

usc_rates_and_bands.notes: USC bands and rates for 2024-2026. Third band reduced from 4% to 3% in 2025 (Budget 2025). Exempt threshold remains €13,000.

prsi_class_a.notes: Employee 4% (2024-2025), increasing to 4.2% (2026). Employer rates: 8.75%/11.05% (2024-2025), 9%/11.25% (2026). Weekly threshold €352.

prsi_class_s.notes: Class S: 4% of all income, minimum contribution €500. Nil if income ≤ €5,000.

pension_relief.notes: Age-related limits (15-40%), earnings cap €115,000. Relief at marginal rate. No change 2024-2026.

filing_deadlines.notes: Pay & File: 31 Oct (paper), mid-Nov (ROS). Preliminary tax due 31 Oct of current year. 4-year claim window.

medical_expenses.notes: Relief at 20% on unreimbursed qualifying expenses. No upper limit. Claim via Form Med 1 or myAccount.

income_protection_relief.notes: Relief at marginal rate on premiums (max 10% of total income). Benefit is taxable as income.
